title: Nanjing_CBD_from_City_Wall.jpg
author: xiquinhosilva
description: Nanjing, the capital of Jiangsu Province in eastern China, is a historic city with over 2,500 years of history, once serving as the capital for several dynasties, including the Ming. Renowned for its cultural heritage, it features landmarks like the ancient city wall, the Confucius Temple, and the Sun Yat-sen Mausoleum. Today, Nanjing is a modern metropolis with a thriving economy, top universities, and a blend of traditional and contemporary architecture. Its strategic location along the Yangtze River has long made it a key center for trade and culture.
